name: lf-basic
description: An LF file at the project root: decide, serve-once per area per session, orient, query, lint, doctor.
notes: The reference case. It pins the exact inject and orientation text, the served-once rule (per area, per session), that a query claims the areas it shows, and that a path no area touches is silent.
